messages:
Priya Menon: Quick heads-up  international candidate arriving early morning next Tue (visa check). Needs interview schedule adjusted for morning customs queue and a secure place to store passport while on-site. Also requested a quiet room and a refundable taxi stipend if customs delay >45m.

Ivy Chen: Candidate details? flight arrival/time/phone? passport handling allowed?

Priya Menon: Candidate: Lukas Müller, +49-30-555-0177. Flight lands 06:10 (SFO). ETA through customs maybe 07:0007:30. He prefers a private locker for passport while interviewing, and a vegetarian breakfast. If customs delay >45m we cover taxi up to $60.

Travel Ops: Noted. We'll pre-approve $60 taxi stipend if customs delay documented. Please have candidate keep boarding pass/arrival stamp and receipt; reimburse via expenses. Shuttle option at 08:00 if he prefers ground transfer.

Facilities Bot: Quiet Room H (1st floor) tentatively reserved 07:1510:00. We can provide a secure lockbox at Security for passport storage; box access requires staff escort. Breakfast delivery scheduled 07:20 (vegetarian wrap + fruit).

Security Desk: We'll print a Visitor badge under "Lukas Müller" and hold passport in secure lockbox at the desk per Priya's instruction. Escort to Quiet Room H at pickup. Please ask Lukas to present passport once for ID and to sign the temporary custody form.

IT Support: Need any laptop or local account for Lukas? If coding exercise planned, tell us OS preference.

Priya Menon: No coding task today, just interviews. Laptop not required. Please ensure guest wifi credentials printed in the room and that Quiet Room H has low lighting and a privacy sign.

Cafe Team: Vegetarian breakfast and decaf coffee for Lukas. Low-fragrance packaging. We'll leave napkins and a bottled water.

Ivy Chen: Can someone paste short run-of-day for calendar? I'll DM Lukas a note about passport custody and the shuttle option. Also confirm whether we should shorten panel slots if customs runs late.

Priya Menon: Run-of-day (short):
```
07:15  Candidate arrives / badge & passport custody (Security)
07:30  Quiet Room check-in + breakfast
07:45  Meet & greet (10m)
07:55  Panel interviews (3x30m w/10m between)
10:15  Wrap + expenses/receipt guidance
```
If customs pushes past 08:00, Travel Ops to release taxi stipend and we shift to a condensed schedule (3x20m) starting when Lukas is ready. Zoom fallback: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback

Security Desk: We'll SMS Priya when passport is received and again when escorting to Quiet Room H. Temporary custody form will be printed at 07:00.

Facilities Bot: Quiet Room H lighting set to low. Guest wifi cred printed and left on table. Lockbox key kept at Security.

Priya Menon: Thanks team  Ivy I'll DM Lukas the pickup notes and the stipend process. Tagging @Facilities Bot @Security Desk @Travel Ops @Cafe Team. :raised_hands:
